messages:
Alex: Hey team — Northpoint IT asked if our DPA + SCCs are fine for the POC. They also want clarity on DSARs, data deletion timing, and whether embeddings are persisted. POC target next week. Any immediate blockers? @Maria @Raj

Maria: Good spot. Who's taking the answers? I can run the POC infra and config the workspace. Need the canned DPA and sub-processor list to share.

Raj: Security TL;DR — we support our standard DPA and the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). Hosted API processes in the region you pick (we can pin eu-west-1 for them). Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) is available if they require no data egress. KMS is supported for Dedicated & Private. Logs: request metadata retained 30 days by default, can be shortened in contract.

Raj: About embeddings — we do NOT use customer inputs to train models. Embeddings are stored only if customer enables the vector DB feature; otherwise we only keep ephemeral caches/kv for the session. We expose a deletion API to remove stored vectors.

Samira (Legal): @Alex send over their DPA template. Our standard DPA + SCCs bundle is pre-approved. For DSARs: hosted flow is verification -> collection -> response within 30 days. We can contractually commit to 30-day DSAR turnaround; exceptions handled case-by-case.

Samira (Legal): Data deletion SLA: primary data removed within 72 hours on hosted by default; backups subject to 30-day deletion window unless we contract shorter retention. For Dedicated/Private we provide custom SLAs. We can include a CSV table of data categories + retention periods in the contract.

Alex: Can we give them an example curl for the deletion API to use during POC?

Raj: Yep — example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/delete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"dataset_id":"np-1234","force":true}'
```
(Explain that this is admin-only and requires creds).

Ellie (Legal Ops): I uploaded our DPA + SCCs bundle and SOC2 report to the internal drive: https://redwood.file/dpa-sccs-v2 (internal). Use the file tagged 2025-06.

Maria: POC logistics — I'll spin up eu-west-1 workspace and enable KMS + SOC2 scans. @DeployBot can you create a trial lease: 1x A10G (or equivalent), 50k token credit, 14-day lease?

DeployBot: Created workspace np-poc-1768 in eu-west-1, lease rwd-8743, assigned to Alex & Maria. :white_check_mark:

Samira (Legal): Heads up — customer asked for sub-processor list and breach notification timing. We provide the sub-processor inventory and SOC2 Type II. Breach notification standard is 72 hours; legal ok to commit in DPA unless risk team flags something.

Raj: For the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire we should pre-fill: encryption at-rest (AES-256), TLS 1.2+, MFA for console, RBAC/IAM roles, KMS key control, pen-tests (annual), vuln scanning cadence. I can draft the answers — what's the expected turnaround?

Alex: POC timeline is tight — need the pre-filled SIG + DPA bundle and deletion API example by EOD tomorrow if possible.

Maria: I'll own the infra + KMS setup. Raj will do SIG pre-fill. Samira will send DPA/SCCs and sub-processor list. Alex will coordinate with the buyer. 

Samira (Legal): One more note — customer wants an explicit clause about not using customer data for model training. We already have that in our DPA. I'll attach the clause snippet in the drive. :thumbsup:
